purpose: Self-Consistent Field (SCF) over the hub: ψ, g, r, R, κ. PFKT is upper-level orchestration before full PKT tuning. AEX closed cycle (EXEC…GUARD) drives ψ updates with Krylov CG/BiCGStab/GMRES acceleration — see fleet-token-ladder.json (fleet-aex). ZTM/ZAT/MTD glossary: fleet-skill-lanes.json.

aliases.PKT: Primary name for P/(K·T); PPTT is deprecated alias
aliases.P: PKT outcome numerator: P_align · P_compact (NOT PFKT P_par)
aliases.ψ: Field state: spec + rules hash + KB version + promoted canon snapshot
aliases.g: Goal vector; mint via goal-field.py (MTD or ZTM)
aliases.r: Result vector; ZAT-verified dims at session end via result-field.py
aliases.R: Residual g − proj_g(r); evolution metric, not optional

pkt.p_formula: P = P_align · P_compact; P_align = 100·dot(g,r)/dot(g,g); P_compact ∈ [0,1] from goal-compact orthogonality

steps.when: F=100 and P_par=100 or operator lift

goal_compact_in_P.role: Multiplicative gate on numerator — wrong compression destroys P direction
goal_compact_in_P.P_compact: 1 − mean(weight⊥) over compacted chunks; weight⊥ = ‖chunk − proj_g(chunk)‖/‖chunk‖
goal_compact_in_P.rule: Compact only along g; never directionless SVD/PCA when g exists

portal_tracks: PFKT F/P_par numerators (pfkt-protocol.json — KT frozen mode)
Policy W* sim (portal JS — not KPI)

sigma.formula: sigma = cos(R_{n-1}, R_n) on aggregated gap vectors

anderson_acceleration.formula: R_predict = R_n - beta*(R_n - R_{n-1}); beta from (dr·dr2)/(dr2·dr2)

relaxed_fixed_point.formula: R_relaxed = omega*R_n + (1-omega)*R_{n-1}; omega adapts from kappa

periodic_pulay.formula: every k steps: Anderson/DIIS; else linear mix
periodic_pulay.ref: Pratapa & Suryanarayana Periodic Pulay; DIIS ≡ Anderson

numerics.note: Orthogonal to PKT denominator; augments hub roll in scf-residual.py; AWARE aggregates seat R → R_hub
